name: toyoura_placeholder_v1
status: PLACEHOLDER. Every entry whose note says PLACEHOLDER is a stand-in so the deck wiring can be proven; the WP-144 P3 calibration (plan 144 sec.3 P3, sec.5.2 K3) replaces it. Nothing in this file is a calibrated Toyoura value.
energy: BA06 (label only: the deck never branches on it; the energy's own flags are the pass-through list material_flags, so an HAR energy is a new flag list, not a deck change)
K0_note: K0 of the geostatic state, used as sigma_h/sigma_v for every row. 0.5 = Loukidis & Salgado (2011) main series as adopted by the ladder deck (footing_ab.py header, 'K0 = 0.5'); Jaky with the DM04 critical-state angle gives 1 - sin 31.2 = 0.48 (same header). OPEN CALIBRATION/DECK DECISION, not a measurement.
e_init_note: null = take the deck's own void ratio (--sand toyoura: e = e_max - Dr (e_max - e_min) with e_max 0.977, e_min 0.597, ladder deck footing_ab.py TYR_EMAX/TYR_EMIN, quoting DM04 p.631 = Verdugo & Ishihara; --dr sets Dr). v0 = 1 + e. A number here overrides.

material_flags_notes.-p0: energy reference pressure (kPa, tension positive). PLACEHOLDER = K2 / AB06 sec.6.1 (tests/test_ladruno_norsand_element.py _P0).
material_flags_notes.-kappa_hat: PLACEHOLDER (BA06 energy). Chosen so the bulk modulus p/kappa_hat = 32 418 kPa at p = 100 kPa = DM04's K for Toyoura (K = 2(1+nu) G / (3(1-2nu)), nu = 0.05, G = G0 p_at (2.97-e)^2/(1+e) sqrt(p/p_at), G0 = 125, e = 0.635, p = 100 = 41 680 kPa: DM04 Table 1 constants as carried in the ladder deck TYR dict). The K2 value 0.01 would be ~3x softer. Calibration replaces it.
material_flags_notes.-mu0: PLACEHOLDER (BA06, alpha0 = 0 so constant shear modulus). = DM04's G at p = 100 kPa, e = 0.635 (41 680 kPa, derivation above). With alpha0 = 0 it does NOT scale with sqrt(p); the HAR energy is the P0 decision (plan sec.2.5).
material_flags_notes.-M: DM04 Table 1 Toyoura Mc = 1.25 (ladder deck TYR['Mc']; = phi_c 31.2 deg).
material_flags_notes.-N: PLACEHOLDER = K2 / AB06 sec.6.1 (0.4). Calibration from Tatsuoka 1986 plane strain (plan sec.3 P3).
material_flags_notes.-rho: PLACEHOLDER = K2 (0.7; ellipticity). Pinned by P3 from the plane-strain vs triaxial friction difference.
material_flags_notes.-chi: PLACEHOLDER = K2 (-3.5, A&B's value for sands). Calibration.
material_flags_notes.-h: PLACEHOLDER = K2 (280, constant-h law, plan sec.2.6). Calibration refits h.
material_flags_notes.-csl: fork-form CSL (needs -p_a): e_c = e0 - lambda_c (-p/p_a)^xi, the p -> 0 safe form (plan sec.2.3).
material_flags_notes.-e0: DM04 Table 1 Toyoura e0 = 0.934 (ladder deck TYR['e0']).
material_flags_notes.-lambda_c: DM04 Table 1 Toyoura lambda_c = 0.019 (ladder deck TYR['lamc']).
material_flags_notes.-xi: DM04 Table 1 Toyoura xi = 0.7 (ladder deck TYR['xi']).
material_flags_notes.-p_a: 100 kPa: DM04 does not tabulate p_at; the ladder deck's own choice (footing_ab.py: 'Gate 0 / WP-150 memo section 12'). Must equal the p_a the calibration used.

pi0.note: Initial image pressure of every geostatic row (no default in the material: -pi0 is required). on_surface: the deck finds, per row, the smallest |pi_i0| the material accepts (bisection on the constructor, which refuses a start outside the surface) and takes |pi_i0| = (1 + margin) x that, i.e. a K0-normally-consolidated start just inside the yield surface. ratio: pi_i0 = -ratio x p (a fixed fraction, K2's pair is 60.4/100). WHICH INITIAL pi_i0 (normally consolidated vs over-consolidated Toyoura) IS A CALIBRATION DECISION the deck cannot make.

p_floor_note: Deck-side census only: the deck counts Gauss points with p' below each value at every step (steps.csv n_p_lt_F, first value) and at the end (summary.json). The material has NO p' floor at HEAD 4cf47419b (grep of SRC/material/nD/LadrunoNorSand*: no Pmin/floor); plan sec.2.7 specifies Pmin <= 0.5 kPa, projected and counted. When the material gains it, add its flag to material_flags (e.g. ["-Pmin", 0.5]) and run F vs F/2 (the 2 % rule, plan sec.5.2).

sources.K2: AB06 sec.6.1 as recorded in tests/test_ladruno_norsand_element.py (_P0.._PI0) and ladrunonorsand plan 144 sec.5
sources.DM04_Toyoura: Dafalias & Manzari 2004 Table 1, as transcribed in Esmeralda ~/ladruno_wp152/deck_toyoura_ladder/footing_ab.py (TYR dict, lines 662-665; copy: ~/wp144/deck/ref_ladder/footing_ab.py)
